column1: # fixture: e4-keys-sphere-deep.tsv -- per-run records of the sphere-regime key sweep.
# The `h` column was ADDED on 2026-08-24 without re-running the sweep, and this
# note is why that is sound rather than convenient.  The sweep that produced
# these rows was invoked as `H=half`, which sweep_keys.sh resolves to h = n/2
# per width and nothing else; the value is therefore determined by the `n`
# already in each row, not guessed from one.  It is recorded because the
# analysis needs it: at h = n/2 the complement of the secret restores the host
# (SFLL.Complement), so whether a returned key is a functional recovery cannot
# be decided without the radius.  Runs from now on record it at measurement
# time -- sweep_keys.sh writes thirteen columns -- and this file is the one
